# Files excluded from the REQUIRED `required-tests` gate because they
# dominate its wall clock. They still run in `full-tests` on every main
# push, with the same quarantine ledger.
#
# Why a subset gates merges: main takes a commit every ~10 min (median,
# measured 2026-08-03 over 39 gaps). A required check must finish inside
# that window or `strict` freshness makes the PR stale before its own run
# lands -- at the full suite's 37 min only 5% of gaps are long enough to
# merge at all. At ~5 min, 79% are.
#
# Selection is measured, not guessed: every file whose tests totalled
# >3.0s in CI run 30779149822 (12,978 tests / 35.6 min). Regenerate after
# a big suite change; keeping a fast file here only costs coverage.
